subject: Distance package returns different output than Windows program

messages.author: 022f6ea89a56cfc6
messages.subject: Distance package returns different output than Windows program
parts:
Has anybody directly compared between the R output and the Windows output? I have been running the same analysis of transect data on the two platforms and I am obtaining very different density and abundance estimates. The fitted detection probability function, QQplot and error structure instead look the same.
Has anyone encountered this problem before?
